skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and explain the preconditions for the emergence of international tax, including concepts, objectives, and principles.
Grasp the principles and objectives of international tax.
Understand the concept, causes, impacts, and methods of avoiding double taxation.
Understand the concept, nature, and objectives of tax treaties.
Understand the concept, objectives, impacts, and methods of managing transfer pricing.
Understand the concept, objectives, forms, and impacts of international tax competition.
Understand the concepts, forms, and impacts of anti-dumping and anti-subsidy taxes in international trade.
Understand the concept, characteristics, applicable objects, types of tax, and calculation methods of foreign contractor tax.
Differentiate between various models of tax treaties by OECD, UN, and the US.
Read and understand the basic contents of tax treaties.
Read and understand the basic contents of current tax policy documents related to VAT, personal income tax, corporate income tax.
Understand Vietnam's integration process and foreign direct investment situation.
Understand and explain Vietnam's commitments on tax and issues related to tax policy and management in the context of integration.
Apply specialized knowledge about international tax and general economic knowledge to analyze current situations and propose solutions for existing issues in international tax management.
Demonstrate active learning, answer questions, choose topics, gather data, analyze data, and present analysis results.
